name: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
summary: Keeper Albagorm sends Alliance fighters from Stonetalon Peak to drive Bloodfury harpies from the ruined Charred Vale. Their removal will clear the way for druids and caretakers to heal the scorched land.

sections.title: The Wounded Valley
sections.body: South of Stonetalon Peak, the Charred Vale lies in ash and smoldering ruins. A lush alpine haven once stood there. A mechanized logging and mining army stripped the trees and let fires rage unchecked. For the guardians of Stonetalon, the woodland's loss to industrial greed is a wound they cannot ignore.

sections.title: The Harpy Menace
sections.body: Bloodfury harpies claimed the ashes left by the mechanical fires. They swarm the smoking lowlands, nest there, and ambush anyone who approaches. Keeper Albagorm and his allies cannot cross the soil to sow seeds of renewal. The harpies bar every outsider's way.

sections.title: Clearing the Path to Renewal
sections.body: The Bloodfury roosts must be broken before restoration can begin. Keeper Albagorm sends seasoned Alliance fighters deep among the tribe to slay its hunters, ambushers, and roguefeathers. Their numbers must fall before the land can be reclaimed for nature and the forest spirits can breathe freely again.

faq.answer: The Charred Vale lies in the southwestern heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. Fire consumed its once-lush forest and scorched it to bedrock. Industrial logging forces exploited the land without restraint.

aliases: who gives reclaiming the charred vale
faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm is a woodland keeper and caretaker at the Alliance settlement on Stonetalon Peak. He protects nature and forest spirits, works to curb desolation in the mountains, and drives back encroaching beasts.

faq.q: Why are harpies living in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: Bloodfury harpies thrive in disrupted, blighted lands. After fire leveled the valley, the opportunistic flock moved into the basin and attacks anyone who tries to enter.

faq.q: Who set fire to the Charred Vale in the first place?
faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm names a greedy mechanized army of industrialists as the cause. Their unchecked logging machinery and explosive expansion brought devastating blazes that consumed the woodland.

faq.q: What must be done after thinning the harpies?
faq.answer: Once Bloodfury numbers are curbed, Keeper Albagorm turns to planting seeds and channeling restorative magic to coax new life from the scorched soil.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: No. Keeper Albagorm works from the Alliance redoubt atop Stonetalon Peak, so only Alliance heroes can clear the Bloodfury harpies for him.

angles.text: As a night elf, you revere Stonetalon's wild forests. Driving vile harpies from sacred groves defiled by foreign engines is an urgent calling.
As a druid, you serve the Cenarion circle and defend nature's harmony. You help the Keepers clear blighted nests so magical reforestation can begin.
As an Alliance hero, you help secure the high passes and southern valleys. You protect vulnerable night elf settlements and sanctuaries across Stonetalon Peak from predatory threats.
